_comment: Demand signals the drops pipeline scores against. Every entry names where the number came from and when it was checked; a signal without a source is a guess and does not belong here. Scores are 0-100 and relative to each other, not absolute market sizes.

agentic-hiring.label: Open agentic AI roles
agentic-hiring.value: 2,401 open roles across 194 companies; 66% of 3,617 tracked AI roles (October 2026)
agentic-hiring.source: Agentic AI Jobs Index, Get Ready for Agents (CC BY 4.0)

agent-ops-skills.label: Skills named most often in agentic postings
agent-ops-skills.value: Python 1,732 · Cloud 972 · RAG 661 · MCP 649 · Kubernetes 624 · TypeScript 508 · LangChain 402 · multi-agent 373 · LangGraph 348 · evals 301

whatsapp-commerce-kenya.label: WhatsApp share of Kenyan online orders
whatsapp-commerce-kenya.value: More than 20% of Kenya's online shopping orders happen on WhatsApp; 80% of Kenyan SMEs name simple, seamless payments as a top requirement for growth
whatsapp-commerce-kenya.source: Mastercard / Flowcart chat-to-pay announcement; Mastercard 2026 SME Confidence Index

mpesa-rails.label: M-Pesa collection capability already running in this repo
mpesa-rails.value: Daraja STK push, callback state machine, payment links and merchant-code reconciliation are implemented and exercised by live tenants

ai-work-applications.label: AI-work application abandonment
ai-work-applications.value: 26 signed up, 159 applications started, 22 completed (13.8%), 4 offers, 3 hired, 0 paid — $566.32 referred to date
ai-work-applications.source: Internal referral funnel, rolling window to 2026-10-29 (docs/BLOG_CONVERSION_ENGINE.md)

build-in-public.label: Proof assets buyers ask for before a deployment call
build-in-public.value: Build logs and teardowns are the cheapest credible asset for selling implementation work; the repo already holds the material

agency-resale.label: Agencies needing a tenant layer to resell conversational commerce
agency-resale.value: Agencies sell funnels and WhatsApp commerce but cannot open a second client without tenant isolation; the layer is the blocker to resale

price_anchors._comment: Only used when a catalogue row has no price. Anchored to what the market charges for comparable written packs, not to what a buyer might pay.
